arc_summary: A nostalgic childhood memory edit that begins with the tender moment of a father lifting his child, letting it breathe to establish warmth. As the music builds, we transition through joyful group activities with increasing energy, hitting a rapid-fire montage of diverse childhood moments at the musical peak around 21s. The edit resolves softly with the intimate hug between children, creating a complete emotional journey from innocence to joyful chaos back to tender connection.
